podcast.body: Phil Collins' 1985 blockbuster LP, which featured Sting providing counterpoint vocals on the ballad "Long, Long Way to Go." "For Phil Collins, who was recording his soon-to-be 1985 blockbuster LP No Jacket Required, Sting provided counterpoint vocals on Phil's haunting ballad long, long way to go."
